perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information includes:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn and less vibrant than usual at work, so he asked if she was okay.
- She told him it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated that.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning and offered to discuss budgeting tips with her.
- Patricia told him she had been overwhelmed with her bills, that discussing it could be helpful, and that she would take him up on it.
- He later worried he might have overstepped, so he told her he hadn’t meant to pry and only wanted to help.
- Patricia reassured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his support.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend.
- He sensed she appreciated his concern but preferred to handle things privately, so he shifted to lighter check-ins.
- He asked about her weekend; she said everything was good and she planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He continued checking in with Patricia at work.
- She told him she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said she was glad to have his support.
- He responded that he was there to help and that they all support each other.
